paper_title: High-Pass Matters: Theoretical Insights and Sheaflet-Based Design for Hypergraph Neural Networks
reuse_value: 把超边、层拉普拉斯、频域分解、滤波重建及最终标签接成上下反向阅读的完整架构。
limitations: The328original native source paths are preserved in their original order.；The central incidence diagram is manually reconstructed with editable shapes and text; coloured edge glows use layered native strokes and the original routing is retained.；Source matrix colours are sampled into native cells. Low/high-pass curves are centreline traces of the published schematic, not recovered experimental data.；The two dense mathematical equations are native glyph contour paths recovered from high-resolution source formula snippets, preserving the original mathematical symbols.；Background radii and shadows, tiny graph icon shapes and gradient surfaces are approximated with native shapes. Source Comic Sans font is retained; matrix annotations use Cambria Math.
dedup_note: 区别旧一般消息传递网络，本图把超图高阶关系和高低频滤波矩阵联系起来，具有独特几何/谱域组合。
